title: Sign up and start your free trial

scenes.say: You can try Sentinel without talking to anyone first. In this video, you'll sign up, set your password and start your free trial.

show.card: Sign up and start your free trial
show.subtitle: Sentinel by DeepTrack · Get started

scenes.say: Go to the sign-up page, headed Start your free Sentinel trial. A trial gives you 14 days and free credits to try every product. No card is needed.
Then your work email. Personal mailboxes, such as Gmail or Yahoo, can't start a trial. Sentinel knows your organization by your email domain, and each organization gets one trial.
Type the name of your bank, SACCO, microfinance or fintech. It becomes your legal name in Settings, and you can change it there later.
Kenya is selected for you. Your country sets your billing currency: Kenya shillings for Kenyan organizations, and US dollars for everyone else.
Then click Start free trial. The form changes to Check your inbox, and DeepTrack emails you an invitation.
Open the email, follow the link and set your password. You land on a page headed Access is being prepared. That's normal: your workspace doesn't exist yet.

show.subtitle: Open the invitation email → set your password → Access is being prepared

scenes.say: In the box headed Start your free 14-day trial, check your organization and country. You can't change the currency yourself later. Add a phone number if you like, accept the terms, and click Start free trial. You become your workspace's Admin.

show.subtitle: Check Organization and Country → accept the terms → Start free trial

scenes.say: A banner on every page shows the days and credits you have left. A Kenyan organization gets 25 credits, about 25 checks. Use them to complete your profile, invite your team and run a few real checks.

show.subtitle: Free trial: 9 days and 18 credits left

scenes.say: After 14 days, new checks pause, but your results and settings are kept. To carry on, click Top up to continue, and pay on the Billing and Credits page.

show.subtitle: Top up to continue → Billing & Credits

scenes.say: That's your free trial, from sign-up to your first day. To learn more, open chapter A1 in Help, Signing up and your free trial.

show.card: Help → A1 Signing up and your free trial
show.subtitle: sentinel.deeptrack.io/help/a1

notes: The form is filled in but Start free trial is only highlighted, never clicked. Don't add Enter or a click on it.
record.mjs records with the signed-in session. /signup is a public route in middleware.ts, so it should still open, but check the first take.
The sign-up example uses the Help chapter's example person (Wanjiku Kamau, wanjiku.kamau@yoursacco.co.ke) and a made-up SACCO, 'Yetu Sacco Society Ltd'. Change it if you'd prefer a Demo name.
The password, access page, trial banner and trial-end steps are title cards: they need a new account or trial state that the Demo Bank session can't show.
Narration says 'about 25 free checks' to match the page text; that is the Kenyan amount. Outside Kenya the trial is 1,000 credits.
